howToPlay: Use your Super to level up through three stages to increase your speed, range, and attack spread. Combine the Power Surge gadget for faster upgrades or the Power Shield gadget for defense and ammo recovery. Manage your upgrades carefully, as they reset when defeated.
gears: Equip the DAMAGE gear to boost your output during firefights and the SHIELD gear to increase your survivability. The SPEED gear is also useful for maintaining mobility across different environments.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy a dynamic progression playstyle that rewards survival and precision movement.
